Sneak-right-click while holding it to enable or disable illumination.
While equipped, grants immunity to Darkness, Blindness, and Nausea.
While equipped, the following conditions grant damage bonuses, which add together:
While alone, gain a %s%% damage bonus
With at least %s nearby enemies, gain a %s%% damage bonus
While facing undead, gain a %s%% damage bonus
After more than %s minutes of continuous combat, gain a %s%% damage bonus
While below %s%% of maximum health, gain a %s%% damage bonus
Nearby enemies and being alone are checked within %s blocks.

%s%% chance to receive 8 ores of one type
%s%% chance to receive 8 ingots of one type

gui.the_long_travail.catalog.valley.trem: 「High Frequency Tremor」 has the harvesting capability of a netherite pickaxe, twice its mining speed, and loses no durability through use.
With The Long Travail equipped and High Frequency Tremor in the main hand, sneak-right-click a block to perform special breaking.
Instantly mine normally breakable blocks. Fortune level and the user's luck are doubled for loot calculation.
With Silk Touch, drops follow Silk Touch rules instead of gaining additional yield from Fortune.
Can break blocks outside the blacklist, including normally unbreakable blocks.
